function tripBatterySummary(trip, km) {
  const pct = Number(trip.battery_percent), cap = Number(trip.battery_capacity), use = Number(trip.battery_consumption);
  if (!(pct > 0 && pct <= 100 && cap >= 5 && cap <= 250 && use >= 5 && use <= 80)) return null;
  const perKm = use / cap, finish = pct - km * perKm, target = pct / 2, targetKm = (pct - target) / perKm, reserveKm = (pct - 20) / perKm;
  return { pct, cap, use, finish, target, targetKm, reserveKm, perKm, km };
}
__name(tripBatterySummary, "tripBatterySummary");
function tripDisplayItems(data) {
  const items = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items || [];
  if (Array.isArray(data) || data.view !== "BATTERY" || !data.battery) {
    return items;
  }
  const b = data.battery;
  if (b.finish >= 20) return [];
  const eligible = items.filter((item) => Number.isFinite(Number(item.km))).map((item) => {
    const distance = Number(item.km);
    const estimatedBattery = b.pct - distance * b.perKm;
    return {
      ...item,
      estimatedBattery,
      distanceFromStart: distance
    };
  }).filter(
    (item) => item.estimatedBattery >= 20 && item.distanceFromStart >= 0
  );
  return eligible.sort((a, c) => {
    const scoreA = Math.abs(a.distanceFromStart - b.targetKm);
    const scoreC = Math.abs(c.distanceFromStart - b.targetKm);
    return scoreA - scoreC || a.distanceFromStart - c.distanceFromStart;
  });
}
__name(tripDisplayItems, "tripDisplayItems");

async function telegram(token, method, payload) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/${method}`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    }
  );
  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorBody = await response.text();
    throw new Error(
      `Telegram HTTP ${response.status}: ${errorBody}`
    );
  }
  const data = await response.json();
  if (!data.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `Telegram API: ${data.description || method}`
    );
  }
  return data;
}
__name(telegram, "telegram");

async function saveState(db, chat, country, mode) {
  await db.prepare(`

    INSERT INTO user_search_state

      (

        chat_id,

        country,

        charging_mode,

        page_offset,

        updated_at

      )

    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

    ON CONFLICT(chat_id) DO UPDATE SET

      country = excluded.country,

      charging_mode = excluded.charging_mode,

      page_offset = 0,

      last_latitude = NULL,

      last_longitude = NULL,

      search_active = 0,

      search_query = NULL,

      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

  `).bind(
    String(chat),
    country,
    mode
  ).run();
}

function distanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  const rad = /* @__PURE__ */ __name2((value) => value * Math.PI / 180, "rad");
  const a = Math.sin(rad(lat2 - lat1) / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(rad(lat1)) * Math.cos(rad(lat2)) * Math.sin(rad(lon2 - lon1) / 2) ** 2;
  return 6371 * 2 * Math.atan2(
    Math.sqrt(a),
    Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - a))
  );
}
__name(distanceKm, "distanceKm");
__name2(distanceKm, "distanceKm");
function matchesMode(station, mode) {
  if (mode === "ALL") {
    return true;
  }
  const type = String(
    station.charger_type || ""
  ).toLowerCase();
  if (mode === "DC") {
    return /dc|سريع|fast/.test(type);
  }
  if (mode === "AC") {
    return /ac|عادي|normal|slow/.test(type) && !/dc|سريع|fast/.test(type);
  }
  return false;
}
__name(matchesMode, "matchesMode");
__name2(matchesMode, "matchesMode");
function isEligible(station) {
  const status = String(
    station.status || ""
  ).toLowerCase();
  if (/تحت الإنشاء|قيد الإنشاء|under construction|planned|مخطط/.test(status)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/معطل|متوقف عن العمل|out of service|permanently closed/.test(status)) {
    return false;
  }
  const lat = Number(station.latitude);
  const lon = Number(station.longitude);
  return station.latitude !== null && station.longitude !== null && station.latitude !== "" && station.longitude !== "" && Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lon) && lat >= -90 && lat <= 90 && lon >= -180 && lon <= 180;
}
__name(isEligible, "isEligible");
__name2(isEligible, "isEligible");
async function findPage(db, lat, lon, state, offset = 0) {
  const query = state.country ? db.prepare(
    "SELECT * FROM stations WHERE country = ?"
  ).bind(state.country) : db.prepare(
    "SELECT * FROM stations"
  );
  const data = await query.all();
  const ordered = (data.results || []).filter(
    (s) => matchesMode(s, state.charging_mode)
  ).filter(isEligible).map((s) => ({
    ...s,
    km: distanceKm(
      lat,
      lon,
      Number(s.latitude),
      Number(s.longitude)
    )
  })).sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km);
  const selected = ordered.slice(
    offset,
    offset + 4
  );
  return {
    stations: selected.slice(0, 3),
    hasMore: selected.length > 3
  };
}
__name(findPage, "findPage");
__name2(findPage, "findPage");
function normalizeSearch(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").toLowerCase().normalize("NFKC").replace(/[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]/g, "").replace(/[أإآٱ]/g, "\u0627").replace(/ى/g, "\u064A").replace(/ة/g, "\u0647").replace(/ـ/g, "").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, " ").trim();
}
__name(normalizeSearch, "normalizeSearch");
__name2(normalizeSearch, "normalizeSearch");
async function searchStations(db, searchText, offset = 0) {
  const keyword = normalizeSearch(
    String(searchText || "").slice(0, 100)
  );
  if (!keyword) {
    return {
      stations: [],
      hasMore: false
    };
  }
  const data = await db.prepare(
    "SELECT * FROM stations"
  ).all();
  const terms = keyword.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const matched = (data.results || []).filter(isEligible).filter((station) => {
    const fields = [
      station.id,
      station.station_id,
      station.station_number,
      station.name,
      station.operator,
      station.country,
      station.description,
      station.city,
      station.address
    ];
    const searchableText = normalizeSearch(
      fields.filter((value) => value != null).join(" ")
    );
    return terms.every(
      (term) => searchableText.includes(term)
    );
  });
  matched.sort((a, b) => {
    const exactMatch = /* @__PURE__ */ __name2((station) => normalizeSearch(station.id) === keyword || normalizeSearch(station.station_id) === keyword || normalizeSearch(station.station_number) === keyword, "exactMatch");
    return Number(exactMatch(b)) - Number(exactMatch(a)) || String(a.name || "").localeCompare(
      String(b.name || ""),
      "ar"
    );
  });
  const selected = matched.slice(
    offset,
    offset + 4
  );
  return {
    stations: selected.slice(0, 3),
    hasMore: selected.length > 3
  };
}
__name(searchStations, "searchStations");
__name2(searchStations, "searchStations");
function stationText(s, index) {
  const display = /* @__PURE__ */ __name2((value) => {
    const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
    if (!text || /^(null|undefined|nan|n\/a|unknown)$/i.test(text)) {
      return "\u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u0639\u0631\u0648\u0641";
    }
    return text;
  }, "display");
  return [
    `${index + 1}. \u26A1 ${display(s.name)}`,
    `\u200F\u{1F194} \u0645\u0639\u0631\u0651\u0641 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629: ${display(s.station_id ?? s.id)}\u200F`,
    `\u{1F30D} \u0627\u0644\u062F\u0648\u0644\u0629: ${display(s.country)}`,
    `\u{1F3E2} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0634\u063A\u0651\u0644: ${display(s.operator)}`,
    `\u{1F50C} \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646: ${display(s.charger_type)}`,
    `\u26A1 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u062F\u0631\u0629: ${display(s.power_kw)}`,
    `\u{1F50B} \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0635\u0644: ${display(s.connector)}`,
    `\u{1F9F5} \u062A\u0648\u0641\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0643\u064A\u0628\u0644: ${display(s.cable_available)}`,
    s.station_number ? `\u{1F522} \u0631\u0642\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629: ${s.station_number}` : "",
    `\u{1F4CB} \u0627\u0644\u062D\u0627\u0644\u0629: ${display(s.status)}`,
    Number.isFinite(s.km) ? `\u{1F4CF} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0628\u062E\u0637 \u0645\u0633\u062A\u0642\u064A\u0645: ${s.km.toFixed(1)} \u0643\u0645` : ""
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
}
__name(stationText, "stationText");

function directionsKeyboard(stations, offset = 0, hasMore = false, morePrefix = "more_stations") {
  const buttons = stations.map((s, i) => [{
    text: `\u{1F5FA}\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0627\u062A\u062C\u0627\u0647\u0627\u062A \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629 ${offset + i + 1}`,
    url: "https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=" + encodeURIComponent(
      `${s.latitude},${s.longitude}`
    )
  }]);
  if (hasMore) {
    buttons.push([{
      text: "\u26A1 \u0639\u0631\u0636 3 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0623\u062E\u0631\u0649",
      callback_data: `${morePrefix}:${offset + 3}`
    }]);
  }
  return {
    inline_keyboard: buttons
  };
}
__name(directionsKeyboard, "directionsKeyboard");
__name2(directionsKeyboard, "directionsKeyboard");
function pageMessage(stations, offset, heading) {
  const content = stations.map(
    (s, i) => stationText(s, offset + i)
  ).join("\n\n\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n");
  const hasDistance = stations.some(
    (s) => Number.isFinite(s.km)
  );
  const notice = hasDistance ? "\n\n\u062A\u0646\u0628\u064A\u0647: \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0627\u062A \u0628\u062E\u0637 \u0645\u0633\u062A\u0642\u064A\u0645 \u0648\u0644\u064A\u0633\u062A \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0627\u062A \u0642\u064A\u0627\u062F\u0629. \u062A\u062D\u0642\u0642 \u0645\u0646 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u0627\u062D\u0646 \u0642\u0628\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0630\u0647\u0627\u0628." : "\n\n\u062A\u062D\u0642\u0642 \u0645\u0646 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u0627\u062D\u0646 \u0642\u0628\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0630\u0647\u0627\u0628.";

__name(pageMessage, "pageMessage");

async function ensureTripTable(db) {
  await db.prepare(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_planner_state (
      chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      step TEXT NOT NULL,
      start_lat REAL,
      start_lon REAL,
      start_name TEXT,
      end_lat REAL,
      end_lon REAL,
      end_name TEXT,
      mode TEXT DEFAULT 'ALL',
      stage TEXT,
      battery_percent REAL,
      battery_capacity REAL,
      battery_consumption REAL,
      display_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'ALL',
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `).run();
  const info = await db.prepare("PRAGMA table_info(trip_planner_state)").all();
  const existing = new Set((info.results || []).map((column) => column.name));
  const additions = {
    stage: "TEXT",
    battery_percent: "REAL",
    battery_capacity: "REAL",
    battery_consumption: "REAL",
    display_mode: "TEXT DEFAULT 'ALL'"
  };
  for (const [column, definition] of Object.entries(additions)) {
    if (!existing.has(column)) {
      try {
        await db.prepare(`ALTER TABLE trip_planner_state ADD COLUMN ${column} ${definition}`).run();
      } catch (error) {
        if (!/duplicate column name/i.test(String(error?.message || error))) throw error;
      }
    }
  }
}
__name(ensureTripTable, "ensureTripTable");
__name2(ensureTripTable, "ensureTripTable");
async function getTrip(db, chat) {
  await ensureTripTable(db);
  return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM trip_planner_state WHERE chat_id = ?").bind(String(chat)).first();
}
__name(getTrip, "getTrip");
__name2(getTrip, "getTrip");
async function setTrip(db, chat, values) {
  await ensureTripTable(db);
  const allowed = [
    "step",
    "start_lat",
    "start_lon",
    "start_name",
    "end_lat",
    "end_lon",
    "end_name",
    "mode",
    "battery_percent",
    "battery_capacity",
    "battery_consumption",
    "display_mode"
  ];
  const keys = Object.keys(values).filter((key) => allowed.includes(key));
  if (!keys.length) return;
  const step = String(values.step || "start_choose");
  await db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO trip_planner_state (chat_id, stage, step)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(chat_id) DO NOTHING
  `).bind(String(chat), step, step).run();
  const updateKeys = keys.includes("step") ? [...keys, "stage"] : keys;
  const updateValues = keys.includes("step") ? [...keys.map((key) => values[key]), step] : keys.map((key) => values[key]);
  const result = await db.prepare(`
    UPDATE trip_planner_state
    SET ${updateKeys.map((key) => key + " = ?").join(", ")},
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE chat_id = ?
  `).bind(...updateValues, String(chat)).run();
  if ((result.meta?.changes ?? 0) < 1) {
    console.error("TRIP_STATE_SAVE_FAILED", String(chat), step);
    throw new Error("TRIP_STATE_SAVE_FAILED");
  }
}
__name(setTrip, "setTrip");
__name2(setTrip, "setTrip");
async function clearTrip(db, chat) {
  await ensureTripTable(db);
  await db.prepare("DELETE FROM trip_planner_state WHERE chat_id = ?").bind(String(chat)).run();
}
__name(clearTrip, "clearTrip");
__name2(clearTrip, "clearTrip");
function validPoint(lat, lon) {
  return Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lon) && lat >= -90 && lat <= 90 && lon >= -180 && lon <= 180;
}
__name(validPoint, "validPoint");
__name2(validPoint, "validPoint");

async function startTrip(env, chat) {
  await batteryEnsureTables(env.DB);
  await env.DB.prepare(
    "DELETE FROM battery_calculator_state WHERE chat_id = ?"
  ).bind(String(chat)).run();
  await clearTrip(env.DB, chat);
  await clearTripResults(env.DB, chat);
  await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "start_choose" });
  await reply(env, chat, pointPrompt(true), TRIP_POINT_MENU);
}

async function findCityPoint(db, name, env) {
  const key = normalizeSearch(name);
  if (key.length < 2) {
    return { error: "\u0627\u0643\u062A\u0628 \u0627\u0633\u0645 \u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u062D\u0631\u0641\u064A\u0646 \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u0642\u0644." };
  }
  const landmarkPoint = GCC_TRAVEL_LANDMARKS.find(
    (row) => String(row[0]).split("|").some((alias) => normalizeSearch(alias) === key)
  );
  if (landmarkPoint) {
    return { name: landmarkPoint[1], lat: landmarkPoint[2], lon: landmarkPoint[3], approximate: true };
  }
  const countryPoint = GCC_COUNTRY_CENTERS.find(
    (row) => String(row[0]).split("|").some((alias) => normalizeSearch(alias) === key)
  );
  if (countryPoint) {
    return { name: countryPoint[1], lat: countryPoint[2], lon: countryPoint[3], approximate: true };
  }
  const found = GCC_CITIES.find(
    (row) => String(row[0]).split("|").some((alias) => normalizeSearch(alias) === key)
  );
  if (found) {
    return {
      name: String(found[0]).split("|")[0],
      lat: Number(found[1]),
      lon: Number(found[2]),
      approximate: true
    };
  }
  const countries = ["sa", "ae", "qa", "kw", "bh", "om"];
  const url = new URL("https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search");
  url.searchParams.set("q", String(name).trim());
  url.searchParams.set("format", "jsonv2");
  url.searchParams.set("addressdetails", "1");
  url.searchParams.set("limit", "5");
  url.searchParams.set("countrycodes", countries.join(","));
  try {
    const cache = caches.default;
    const cacheKey = new Request(url.toString());
    let response = await cache.match(cacheKey);
    if (!response) {
      if (!env?.GEO_LIMITER) {
        return { error: "\u062E\u062F\u0645\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0633\u0639 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u0641\u0639\u0644\u0629 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u064A\u0627. \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u0643 \u0628\u062F\u0644\u0627 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0633\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629." };
      }
      const geoId = env.GEO_LIMITER.idFromName("gcc-nominatim-global");
      const geoStub = env.GEO_LIMITER.get(geoId);
      const permit = await geoStub.acquire();
      if (!permit.allowed) {
        return { error: "\u23F3 \u064A\u0648\u062C\u062F \u0636\u063A\u0637 \u0645\u0624\u0642\u062A \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0639\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u0646. \u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644 \u0628\u0639\u062F \u062B\u0648\u0627\u0646 \u0623\u0648 \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639." };
      }
      response = await fetch(url.toString(), {
        headers: {
          "Accept": "application/json",
          "Accept-Language": "ar,en;q=0.8",
          "User-Agent": "GCC-EV-Chargers-Bot/1.0 (https://t.me/GCC_EV_Chargers_bot)"
        },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8e3)
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        const copy = new Response(response.clone().body, response);
        copy.headers.set("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=2592000");
        await cache.put(cacheKey, copy);
      }
    }
    if (!response.ok) {
      return {
        error: "\u062A\u0639\u0630\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0639\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u064A\u0627. \u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644 \u0645\u0631\u0629 \u0623\u062E\u0631\u0649 \u0623\u0648 \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639."
      };
    }
    const results = await response.json();
    const allowed = new Set(countries);
    const match = results.find((item) => {
      const lat = Number(item.lat);
      const lon = Number(item.lon);
      const country = String(item.address?.country_code || "").toLowerCase();
      const placeType = String(item.addresstype || item.type || "").toLowerCase();
      const category = String(item.category || item.class || "").toLowerCase();
      const isSettlement = ["city", "town", "village", "hamlet", "municipality", "suburb", "neighbourhood", "locality", "county", "state", "region", "province", "district"].includes(placeType);
      const isAirport = placeType === "aerodrome" || placeType === "airport" || category === "aeroway" && placeType === "aerodrome";
      const isBorder = ["border_control", "border_crossing", "checkpoint", "crossing"].includes(placeType) || category === "barrier" && placeType === "border_control";
      const requested = normalizeSearch(name);
      const named = normalizeSearch([item.name, item.display_name?.split(",")[0]].filter(Boolean).join(" "));
      const significant = requested.split(" ").filter((word) => word.length >= 3 && !["border", "crossing", "airport", "international", "\u0645\u0646\u0641\u0630", "\u0645\u0637\u0627\u0631", "\u0627\u0644\u062D\u062F\u0648\u062F\u064A"].includes(word));
      const relatedName = significant.length > 0 && significant.every((word) => named.includes(word));
      return allowed.has(country) && isGccPoint(lat, lon) && (isSettlement || (isAirport || isBorder) && relatedName);
    });
    if (!match) {
      return {
        error: "\u0644\u0645 \u0623\u062C\u062F \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0637\u0627\u0628\u0642\u064B\u0627 \u062F\u0627\u062E\u0644 \u062F\u0648\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u062E\u0644\u064A\u062C. \u062C\u0631\u0651\u0628 \u0627\u0633\u0645\u064B\u0627 \u0622\u062E\u0631 \u0623\u0648 \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639 \u0645\u0628\u0627\u0634\u0631\u0629."
      };
    }
    return {
      name: String(match.name || match.display_name.split(",")[0]).trim(),
      lat: Number(match.lat),
      lon: Number(match.lon),
      approximate: true
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("CITY_SEARCH_ERROR:", error?.stack || String(error));
    return {
      error: "\u062E\u062F\u0645\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0639\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u0646 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u062A\u0627\u062D\u0629 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u064A\u0627. \u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644 \u0644\u0627\u062D\u0642\u0627 \u0623\u0648 \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639."
    };
  }
}

async function acceptTripPoint(env, chat, trip, point) {
  const starting = trip.step.startsWith("start_");
  if (starting) {
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, {
      start_lat: point.lat,
      start_lon: point.lon,
      start_name: point.name,
      step: "end_choose"
    });
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      `\u2705 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0646\u0637\u0644\u0627\u0642: ${point.name}

` + (point.approximate ? "\u2139\uFE0F \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629 \u062A\u0642\u062F\u064A\u0631\u064A \u0627\u0639\u062A\u0645\u0627\u062F\u064B\u0627 \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0645\u0631\u0643\u0632 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629.\n\n" : "") + pointPrompt(false),
      TRIP_POINT_MENU
    );
  } else {
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, {
      end_lat: point.lat,
      end_lon: point.lon,
      end_name: point.name,
      step: "mode_choose"
    });
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      `\u2705 \u0627\u0644\u0648\u062C\u0647\u0629: ${point.name}

\u26A1 \u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629:`,
      TRIP_MODE_MENU
    );
  }
}

var ROUTES_PER_USER_24H = 1;

async function ensureRouteQuotaTables(db) {
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS route_fair_use_users (
    chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )`).run();
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS route_fair_use_buckets (
    bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )`).run();
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS route_paid_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    chat_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minute_bucket TEXT NOT NULL,
    day_bucket TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RESERVED',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  )`).run();
}

async function finishPaidRouteReservation(db, quota, outcome) {
  if (!quota?.paidReservationId) return false;
  const status = outcome === "USED" ? "USED" : "RELEASED";
  const reservation = await db.prepare(`UPDATE route_paid_reservations
    SET status = ? WHERE reservation_id = ? AND status = 'RESERVED'
    RETURNING chat_id, window_start, minute_bucket, day_bucket`).bind(status, quota.paidReservationId).first();
  if (!reservation) return false;
  if (status === "RELEASED") {
    await db.batch([
      db.prepare("UPDATE route_fair_use_users SET used = MAX(0, used - 1) WHERE chat_id = ? AND window_start = ?").bind(reservation.chat_id, reservation.window_start),
      db.prepare("UPDATE route_fair_use_buckets SET used = MAX(0, used - 1) WHERE bucket = ?").bind(reservation.minute_bucket),
      db.prepare("UPDATE route_fair_use_buckets SET used = MAX(0, used - 1) WHERE bucket = ?").bind(reservation.day_bucket)
    ]);
  }
  return true;
}
__name(finishPaidRouteReservation, "finishPaidRouteReservation");
__name2(finishPaidRouteReservation, "finishPaidRouteReservation");
async function calculateDrivingRoute(env, trip) {
  const apiKey = String(env.ORS_API_KEY || "").trim();
  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error("ORS_API_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED");
  }
  const startLon = Number(trip.start_lon);
  const startLat = Number(trip.start_lat);
  const endLon = Number(trip.end_lon);
  const endLat = Number(trip.end_lat);
  if (!Number.isFinite(startLon) || !Number.isFinite(startLat) || !Number.isFinite(endLon) || !Number.isFinite(endLat)) {
    throw new Error("INVALID_TRIP_COORDINATES");
  }
  const url = "https://api.heigit.org/openrouteservice/v2/directions/driving-car/geojson";
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4e4);
  try {
    let response;
    for (const radius of [350, 3e3]) {
      response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Authorization": apiKey,
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Accept": "application/geo+json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          coordinates: [
            [startLon, startLat],
            [endLon, endLat]
          ],
          radiuses: [radius, radius],
          instructions: false
        }),
        signal: controller.signal
      });
      console.log("ORS_RESPONSE_STATUS:", response.status, "RADIUS:", radius);
      if (response.ok) break;
      const errorText = await response.text();
      console.error("ORS_ROUTING_ERROR:", response.status, errorText.slice(0, 500));
      if (response.status !== 404 || radius === 3e3) {
        throw new Error("ORS_HTTP_" + response.status);
      }
    }
    const data = await response.json();
    const route = data.features?.[0];
    if (!route || !Array.isArray(route.geometry?.coordinates) || route.geometry.coordinates.length < 2) {
      throw new Error("NO_DRIVING_ROUTE");
    }
    const summary = route.properties?.summary;
    if (!summary || !Number.isFinite(Number(summary.distance)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(summary.duration))) {
      throw new Error("INVALID_ROUTE_SUMMARY");
    }
    return {
      km: Number(summary.distance) / 1e3,
      minutes: Number(summary.duration) / 60,
      // Keep the existing bot format: [latitude, longitude].
      points: route.geometry.coordinates.map((pair) => [
        Number(pair[1]),
        Number(pair[0])
      ])
    };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
  }
}
__name(calculateDrivingRoute, "calculateDrivingRoute");
__name2(calculateDrivingRoute, "calculateDrivingRoute");
function distanceFromRoute(points, lat, lon) {
  let best = Infinity;
  let position = 0;
  let passed = 0;
  const radians = Math.PI / 180;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    const a = points[i - 1];
    const b = points[i];
    const cosine = Math.cos((a[0] + b[0]) / 2 * radians);
    const x1 = a[1] * cosine * 111.195;
    const y1 = a[0] * 111.195;
    const x2 = b[1] * cosine * 111.195;
    const y2 = b[0] * 111.195;
    const x = lon * cosine * 111.195;
    const y = lat * 111.195;
    const dx = x2 - x1;
    const dy = y2 - y1;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(
      1,
      ((x - x1) * dx + (y - y1) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy || 1)
    ));
    const gap = Math.hypot(x - (x1 + t * dx), y - (y1 + t * dy));
    const segmentKm = distanceKm(a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1]);
    if (gap < best) {
      best = gap;
      position = passed + segmentKm * t;
    }
    passed += segmentKm;
  }
  return { km: best, position };
}
__name(distanceFromRoute, "distanceFromRoute");
__name2(distanceFromRoute, "distanceFromRoute");
async function ensureTripResultsTable(db) {
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_planner_results (

    chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, station_ids TEXT NOT NULL,

    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

  )`).run();
}
__name(ensureTripResultsTable, "ensureTripResultsTable");

async function clearTripResults(db, chat) {
  await ensureTripResultsTable(db);
  await db.prepare("DELETE FROM trip_planner_results WHERE chat_id = ?").bind(String(chat)).run();
}

async function showTripPage(env, chat, offset = 0) {
  await ensureTripResultsTable(env.DB);
  const result = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT station_ids FROM trip_planner_results WHERE chat_id = ?").bind(String(chat)).first();
  if (!result) {
    await reply(env, chat, "\u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u062A \u0646\u062A\u0627\u0626\u062C \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629. \u0627\u0628\u062F\u0623 \u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F\u0629.");
    return;
  }
  const data = JSON.parse(result.station_ids);
  const items = tripDisplayItems(data);
  const group = items.slice(offset, offset + 3);
  if (!group.length) return;
  const rows = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM stations").all();
  const byId = new Map((rows.results || []).map((station) => [String(station.id), station]));
  const stations = group.map((item) => {
    const station = byId.get(String(item.id));
    return station ? { ...station, routeGap: item.gap, routeKm: item.km, estimatedBattery: item.estimatedBattery } : null;
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if (!stations.length) {
    await reply(env, chat, "\u062A\u0639\u0630\u0631 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0647\u0630\u0647 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A\u061B \u0631\u0628\u0645\u0627 \u062A\u063A\u064A\u0631\u062A \u0628\u064A\u0627\u0646\u0627\u062A\u0647\u0627.");
    return;
  }
  const batteryView = !Array.isArray(data) && data.view === "BATTERY";
  const details = stations.map(
    (station, index) => {
      const extra = batteryView && Number.isFinite(Number(station.routeKm)) ? `
\u{1F6E3}\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0646\u0637\u0644\u0627\u0642 \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631: ${Number(station.routeKm).toFixed(0)} \u0643\u0645 \u062A\u0642\u0631\u064A\u0628\u064B\u0627
\u{1F50B} \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0642\u062F\u0631\u0629 \u0639\u0646\u062F \u0645\u0648\u0636\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629: ${Number(station.estimatedBattery).toFixed(1)}%` : "";
      return stationText(station, offset + index) + `
\u2194\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0642\u0631\u0628 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0642\u0631\u064A\u0628\u064A \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631: ${station.routeGap.toFixed(1)} \u0643\u0645` + extra;
    }
  ).join("\n\n\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n");
  const markup = directionsKeyboard(stations, offset, false);
  if (offset + 3 < items.length) markup.inline_keyboard.push([{
    text: "\u26A1 \u0639\u0631\u0636 3 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0623\u062E\u0631\u0649",
    callback_data: `trip_more:${offset + 3}`
  }]);
  await reply(env, chat, `\u26A1 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629

${details}

${batteryView ? "\u26A0\uFE0F \u062A\u0646\u0628\u064A\u0647: \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0648\u0646\u0633\u0628\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u062A\u0642\u062F\u064A\u0631\u064A\u062A\u0627\u0646 \u0648\u0644\u0627 \u062A\u0634\u0645\u0644\u0627\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0644\u062A\u0641\u0627\u0641 \u0627\u0644\u0641\u0639\u0644\u064A \u0644\u0644\u0648\u0635\u0648\u0644 \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u0627\u062D\u0646. \u062A\u0623\u0643\u062F \u0645\u0646 \u062A\u0648\u0641\u0631 \u0627\u062D\u062A\u064A\u0627\u0637\u064A \u0643\u0627\u0641\u064D." : ""}

\u062A\u062D\u0642\u0642 \u0645\u0646 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u0627\u062D\u0646 \u0642\u0628\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0630\u0647\u0627\u0628.`, markup);
}

async function showTripResults(env, chat, trip) {
  await reply(env, chat, "\u23F3 \u062C\u0627\u0631\u064A \u062D\u0633\u0627\u0628 \u0637\u0631\u064A\u0642 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u064A\u0627\u062F\u0629 \u0648\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646...");
  if (!String(env.ORS_API_KEY || "").trim()) {
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "mode_choose" });
    await reply(env, chat, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u062E\u062F\u0645\u0629 \u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0631\u0642 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u0647\u064A\u0623\u0629. \u0623\u0636\u0641 ORS_API_KEY \u0636\u0645\u0646 Secrets \u0641\u064A Cloudflare.", TRIP_MODE_MENU);
    return false;
  }
  let quota;
  try {
    quota = await reserveRouteQuota(env.DB, chat);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Fair-use quota error", error);
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "mode_choose" });
    await reply(env, chat, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u062A\u0639\u0630\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0642\u0642 \u0645\u0646 \u0631\u0635\u064A\u062F \u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0627\u062A \u0645\u0624\u0642\u062A\u064B\u0627. \u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644 \u0645\u062C\u062F\u062F\u064B\u0627 \u0644\u0627\u062D\u0642\u064B\u0627.", TRIP_MODE_MENU);
    return false;
  }
  if (!quota.ok) {
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "mode_choose" });
    await reply(env, chat, quota.message, TRIP_MODE_MENU);
    return false;
  }
  let route;
  try {
    route = await calculateDrivingRoute(env, trip);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Routing failed", error);
    if (quota?.paidReservationId) {
      try {
        await finishPaidRouteReservation(env.DB, quota, "RELEASED");
      } catch (refundError) {
        console.error("PAID_ROUTE_REFUND_FAILED", refundError);
      }
    }
    if (quota?.freeTrial) {
      await env.DB.prepare("DELETE FROM route_free_trials WHERE telegram_user_id=? AND status='RESERVED' AND created_at=?").bind(quota.trialUserId, quota.reservationId).run();
    }
    const missing = String(error).includes("ORS_API_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED");
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "mode_choose" });
    await reply(env, chat, missing ? "\u26A0\uFE0F \u062E\u062F\u0645\u0629 \u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0631\u0642 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u0647\u064A\u0623\u0629. \u0623\u0636\u0641 ORS_API_KEY \u0636\u0645\u0646 Secrets \u0641\u064A \u0625\u0639\u062F\u0627\u062F\u0627\u062A Cloudflare \u062B\u0645 \u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0644\u0625\u0639\u0627\u062F\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629." : "\u26A0\uFE0F \u062A\u0639\u0630\u0631 \u062D\u0633\u0627\u0628 \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u064A\u0627\u062F\u0629. \u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0644\u0625\u0639\u0627\u062F\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629 \u0623\u0648 \u0627\u0636\u063A\u0637 \u0631\u062C\u0648\u0639.", TRIP_MODE_MENU);
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const rows = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM stations").all();
    const stations = (rows.results || []).filter(isEligible).filter((station) => matchesMode(station, trip.mode || "ALL")).map((station) => {
      const near = distanceFromRoute(
        route.points,
        Number(station.latitude),
        Number(station.longitude)
      );
      return { ...station, routeGap: near.km, routePosition: near.position };
    }).filter((station) => station.routeGap <= 15).sort((a, b) => a.routePosition - b.routePosition || a.routeGap - b.routeGap);
    const heading = `\u{1F5FA}\uFE0F ${trip.start_name} \u2190 ${trip.end_name}
\u{1F6E3}\uFE0F \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u064A\u0627\u062F\u0629: ${route.km.toFixed(0)} \u0643\u0645
\u23F1\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0642\u0631\u064A\u0628\u064A\u0629: ${Math.round(route.minutes)} \u062F\u0642\u064A\u0642\u0629
\u26A1 \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646: ${trip.mode}
\u{1F50C} \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0645\u0642\u0631\u0628\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631: ${stations.length}`;
    if (quota?.freeTrial) {
      const claimed = await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE route_free_trials SET status='USED', used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE telegram_user_id=? AND status='RESERVED' AND created_at=?").bind(quota.trialUserId, quota.reservationId).run();
      if (Number(claimed.meta?.changes || 0) !== 1) {
        await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "mode_choose" });
        await reply(env, chat, "\u23F3 \u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u062A \u0635\u0644\u0627\u062D\u064A\u0629 \u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0628\u0642\u0629. \u0623\u0639\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F.", TRIP_MODE_MENU);
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (quota?.paidReservationId) {
      const committed = await finishPaidRouteReservation(env.DB, quota, "USED");
      if (!committed) {
        await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "mode_choose" });
        await reply(env, chat, "\u23F3 \u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u062A \u0635\u0644\u0627\u062D\u064A\u0629 \u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0628\u0642\u0629. \u0623\u0639\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629.", TRIP_MODE_MENU);
        return false;
      }
    }
    await reply(env, chat, heading + "\n\n\u2139\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0636\u0645\u0646 15 \u0643\u0645 \u0647\u0646\u062F\u0633\u064A\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631\u060C \u0648\u0644\u064A\u0633\u062A \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0641\u0627\u0641 \u0628\u0627\u0644\u0633\u064A\u0627\u0631\u0629. \u0642\u062F \u062A\u062A\u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0627\u0628\u0631\u0629 \u0644\u0644\u062D\u062F\u0648\u062F \u062E\u062F\u0645\u0629 \u0645\u0633\u0627\u0631\u0627\u062A \u062A\u062F\u0639\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0639\u0627\u0628\u0631. \u062A\u062D\u0642\u0642 \u0645\u0646 \u0625\u0645\u0643\u0627\u0646\u064A\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0648\u0635\u0648\u0644 \u0648\u062D\u0627\u0644\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u0627\u062D\u0646.");
    await ensureTripResultsTable(env.DB);
    const battery = tripBatterySummary(trip, route.km);
    const serialized = JSON.stringify({ view: "ALL", battery, items: stations.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, gap: s.routeGap, km: route.km > 0 ? s.routePosition / Math.max(1e-3, route.points.reduce((sum, p, i) => i ? sum + distanceKm(route.points[i - 1][0], route.points[i - 1][1], p[0], p[1]) : sum, 0)) * route.km : 0 })) });
    await env.DB.prepare(`INSERT INTO trip_planner_results (chat_id, station_ids, updated_at)

    VALUES (?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

    ON CONFLICT(chat_id) DO UPDATE SET station_ids = excluded.station_ids,

    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`).bind(String(chat), serialized).run();
    if (battery) {
      const status = battery.finish >= 20 ? "\u2705 \u064A\u0645\u0643\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0648\u0635\u0648\u0644 \u0646\u0638\u0631\u064A\u064B\u0627 \u062F\u0648\u0646 \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0645\u0639 \u0627\u062D\u062A\u064A\u0627\u0637\u064A 20%." : "\u26A0\uFE0F \u064A\u064F\u0646\u0635\u062D \u0628\u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0623\u062B\u0646\u0627\u0621 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629.";
      await reply(env, chat, `\u{1F50B} \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u0639\u0646\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0646\u0637\u0644\u0627\u0642: ${battery.pct}%
\u{1F3C1} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062A\u0648\u0642\u0639 \u0639\u0646\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0648\u0635\u0648\u0644: ${battery.finish.toFixed(1)}%
\u{1F3AF} \u0645\u0633\u062A\u0648\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B: ${battery.target.toFixed(1)}% \u0628\u0639\u062F ${battery.targetKm.toFixed(0)} \u0643\u0645 \u062A\u0642\u0631\u064A\u0628\u064B\u0627
${status}

\u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0637\u0631\u064A\u0642\u0629 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A:`, TRIP_DISPLAY_MENU);
    } else {
      await reply(env, chat, "\u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0637\u0631\u064A\u0642\u0629 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A:", TRIP_DISPLAY_MENU);
    }
    try {
      await batterySaveRoute(env, chat, route.km);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("BATTERY_ROUTE_SAVE_FAILED", error);
    }
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if (quota?.paidReservationId) {
      try {
        await finishPaidRouteReservation(env.DB, quota, "RELEASED");
      } catch (refundError) {
        console.error("PAID_ROUTE_REFUND_FAILED", refundError);
      }
    }
    if (quota?.freeTrial) {
      await env.DB.prepare("DELETE FROM route_free_trials WHERE telegram_user_id=? AND status='RESERVED' AND created_at=?").bind(quota.trialUserId, quota.reservationId).run();
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

async function handleTripMore(env, callback) {
  const chat = callback.message?.chat?.id;
  const match = /^trip_more:(\d+)$/.exec(callback.data || "");
  if (!chat || !match) return;
  const offset = Number(match[1]);
  await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: callback.id });
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 3 || offset > 3e3 || offset % 3 !== 0) return;
  await showTripPage(env, chat, offset);
}

async function handleTripText(env, chat, text, trip) {
  if (text === "\u{1F519} \u0631\u062C\u0648\u0639") {
    if (trip.step === "mode_choose") {
      await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "end_choose" });
      await reply(env, chat, pointPrompt(false), TRIP_POINT_MENU);
    } else if (trip.step === "end_text") {
      await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "end_choose" });
      await reply(env, chat, pointPrompt(false), TRIP_POINT_MENU);
    } else if (trip.step === "end_choose") {
      await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "start_choose" });
      await reply(env, chat, pointPrompt(true), TRIP_POINT_MENU);
    } else if (trip.step === "start_text") {
      await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "start_choose" });
      await reply(env, chat, pointPrompt(true), TRIP_POINT_MENU);
    } else {
      await clearTrip(env.DB, chat);
      await reply(env, chat, "\u{1F3E0} \u0639\u062F\u062A \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u0627\u0626\u0645\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u0626\u064A\u0633\u064A\u0629.", MAIN_MENU);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (text === "\u{1F50D} \u0643\u062A\u0627\u0628\u0629 \u0627\u0633\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629" && trip.step.endsWith("_choose")) {
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, {
      step: trip.step.startsWith("start") ? "start_text" : "end_text"
    });
    await reply(env, chat, "\u{1F50D} \u0627\u0643\u062A\u0628 \u0627\u0633\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0646\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0622\u0646 (\u0645\u062B\u0644: \u0627\u0644\u062E\u0628\u0631 \u0623\u0648 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u064A\u0627\u0636).", TRIP_POINT_MENU);
    return;
  }
  if (text === "\u{1F4CD} \u0625\u0631\u0633\u0627\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639") {
    await reply(env, chat, "\u{1F4CD} \u0627\u0636\u063A\u0637 \u0632\u0631 \u0625\u0631\u0633\u0627\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u060C \u0623\u0648 \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0646 \u062E\u0631\u064A\u0637\u0629 Telegram.", TRIP_POINT_MENU);
    return;
  }
  if (["start_choose", "start_text", "end_choose", "end_text"].includes(trip.step)) {
    const point = await findCityPoint(env.DB, text, env);
    if (point.error) {
      await reply(env, chat, `\u26A0\uFE0F ${point.error}`, TRIP_POINT_MENU);
      return;
    }
    await acceptTripPoint(env, chat, trip, point);
    return;
  }
  if (trip.step === "mode_choose") {
    const options = {
      "\u26A1 \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0633\u0631\u064A\u0639 DC \u0641\u0642\u0637": "DC",
      "\u{1F50C} \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0639\u0627\u062F\u064A AC \u0641\u0642\u0637": "AC",
      "\u{1F50B} \u062C\u0645\u064A\u0639 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646": "ALL"
    };
    if (!options[text]) {
      await reply(env, chat, "\u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u0627\u0626\u0645\u0629.", TRIP_MODE_MENU);
      return;
    }
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { step: "battery_percent", mode: options[text] });
    await reply(env, chat, "\u{1F50B} \u0643\u0645 \u0646\u0633\u0628\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062D\u0627\u0644\u064A\u0629\u061F \u0627\u0643\u062A\u0628 \u0631\u0642\u0645\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0646 1 \u0625\u0644\u0649 100 (\u0645\u062B\u0627\u0644: 80).");
    return;
  }
  if (["battery_percent", "battery_capacity", "battery_consumption"].includes(trip.step)) {
    const value = Number(text.replace(",", "."));
    const rules = { battery_percent: [1, 100, "battery_capacity", "\u{1F50B} \u0645\u0627 \u0633\u0639\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u0628\u0627\u0644\u0643\u064A\u0644\u0648\u0648\u0627\u0637 \u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629 kWh\u061F \u0645\u062B\u0627\u0644: 100"], battery_capacity: [5, 250, "battery_consumption", "\u26A1 \u0645\u0627 \u0645\u062A\u0648\u0633\u0637 \u0627\u0633\u062A\u0647\u0644\u0627\u0643 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u064A\u0627\u0631\u0629 kWh/100km\u061F \u0645\u062B\u0627\u0644: 22"], battery_consumption: [5, 80, "calculating", ""] };
    const [min, max, next, prompt] = rules[trip.step];
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < min || value > max) {
      await reply(env, chat, `\u26A0\uFE0F \u0623\u062F\u062E\u0644 \u0631\u0642\u0645\u064B\u0627 \u0628\u064A\u0646 ${min} \u0648${max}.`);
      return;
    }
    await setTrip(env.DB, chat, { [trip.step]: value, step: next });
    if (prompt) {
      await reply(env, chat, prompt);
      return;
    }
    const current = await getTrip(env.DB, chat);
    const completed = await showTripResults(env, chat, current);
    if (completed) await clearTrip(env.DB, chat);
    return;
  }
  await reply(env, chat, pointPrompt(trip.step.startsWith("start")), TRIP_POINT_MENU);
}

async function readRouteUsage(db, userId) {
  await ensureRouteQuotaTables(db);
  const trial = await db.prepare("SELECT status FROM route_free_trials WHERE telegram_user_id=?").bind(String(userId)).first();
  const record = await db.prepare(
    "SELECT window_start, used FROM route_fair_use_users WHERE chat_id = ?"
  ).bind(String(userId)).first();
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1e3);
  const started = Number(record?.window_start);
  if (!record || !Number.isFinite(started) || started + 86400 <= now) {
    return { used: 0, resetsAt: null, trialUsed: trial?.status === "USED" };
  }
  return { used: Math.max(0, Number(record.used) || 0), resetsAt: started + 86400, trialUsed: trial?.status === "USED" };
}

  const list = (rows.results || []).map((r) => `#${r.id} \u2014 ${PLANS[r.plan]?.name || r.plan} \u2014 ${r.status} \u2014 ${r.created_at}`);

async function previewSubscription(env, callback, planCode) {
  const userId = String(callback.from.id);
  const plan = PLANS[planCode];
  if (!plan || callback.message?.chat?.type !== "private" || String(callback.message.chat.id) !== userId) return;
  const message = `\u{1F48E} \u062A\u0641\u0627\u0635\u064A\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0627\u0642\u0629

\u{1F4B0} \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0639\u0631: ${plan.price} \u0631\u064A\u0627\u0644 \u0633\u0639\u0648\u062F\u064A
\u{1F4C5} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u0629: 30 \u064A\u0648\u0645\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0646 \u0645\u0648\u0627\u0641\u0642\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u062F\u0627\u0631\u0629

\u2728 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0645\u064A\u0632\u0627\u062A:

async function chooseSubscription(env, callback, planCode) {
  const userId = String(callback.from.id);
  const plan = PLANS[planCode];
  if (!plan || callback.message?.chat?.type !== "private" || String(callback.message.chat.id) !== userId) return;
  const existing = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id FROM subscription_requests WHERE telegram_user_id = ? AND status IN ('AWAITING_RECEIPT','PENDING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").bind(userId).first();
  if (existing) {
    await reply(env, userId, `\u26A0\uFE0F \u0644\u062F\u064A\u0643 \u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0645\u0641\u062A\u0648\u062D \u0631\u0642\u0645 #${existing.id}. \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0625\u064A\u0635\u0627\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0648\u064A\u0644 \u0647\u0646\u0627 \u0644\u0625\u0643\u0645\u0627\u0644\u0647\u060C \u0623\u0648 \u0627\u0646\u062A\u0638\u0631 \u0645\u0631\u0627\u062C\u0639\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u062F\u0627\u0631\u0629.`);
    return;
  }
  const bank = String(env.BANK_TRANSFER_DETAILS || "").trim();
  if (!bank) {
    await reply(env, userId, "\u23F3 \u0627\u0633\u062A\u0642\u0628\u0627\u0644 \u0637\u0644\u0628\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u062A\u0627\u062D \u0645\u0624\u0642\u062A\u064B\u0627 \u062D\u062A\u0649 \u062A\u0639\u062A\u0645\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0625\u062F\u0627\u0631\u0629 \u0628\u064A\u0627\u0646\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0648\u064A\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0646\u0643\u064A.");
    return;
  }
  const inserted = await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO subscription_requests (telegram_user_id, telegram_username, customer_name, plan, amount_sar, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'AWAITING_RECEIPT') RETURNING id").bind(userId, callback.from.username || null, [callback.from.first_name, callback.from.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || null, planCode, plan.price).first();
  await reply(env, userId, `\u{1F48E} \u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643 #${inserted.id}
\u0627\u0644\u0628\u0627\u0642\u0629: ${plan.name}
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0628\u0644\u063A: ${plan.price} \u0631\u064A\u0627\u0644 \u0633\u0639\u0648\u062F\u064A
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u0629: 30 \u064A\u0648\u0645\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0641\u0642\u0629

\u{1F3E6} \u0628\u064A\u0627\u0646\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0648\u064A\u0644:
${bank}

\u{1F4F8} \u0628\u0639\u062F \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0648\u064A\u0644 \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0635\u0648\u0631\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u064A\u0635\u0627\u0644 \u0623\u0648 \u0645\u0644\u0641 PDF \u0641\u064A \u0647\u0630\u0647 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0627\u062F\u062B\u0629.

async function receiveSubscriptionReceipt(env, message) {
  if (!isPrivate(message)) return false;
  const userId = String(message.from?.id || "");
  if (!userId || userId !== String(message.chat.id)) return false;
  const photo = message.photo?.at(-1)?.file_id;
  const doc = message.document;
  const isPdf = doc?.mime_type === "application/pdf";
  if (!photo && !isPdf) return false;
  const pending = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id, plan, amount_sar FROM subscription_requests WHERE telegram_user_id = ? AND status = 'AWAITING_RECEIPT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").bind(userId).first();
  if (!pending) return false;
  const adminGroup = String(env.ADMIN_GROUP_ID || "").trim();
  if (!/^-\d+$/.test(adminGroup)) {
    await reply(env, userId, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u062A\u0639\u0630\u0631 \u0625\u0631\u0633\u0627\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u064A\u0635\u0627\u0644 \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u062F\u0627\u0631\u0629 \u062D\u0627\u0644\u064A\u064B\u0627. \u0623\u0639\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0629 \u0644\u0627\u062D\u0642\u064B\u0627.");
    return true;
  }
  const plan = PLANS[pending.plan];
  const caption = `\u{1F48E} \u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643 #${pending.id}
\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0645\u064A\u0644: ${[message.from.first_name, message.from.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0633\u062A\u062E\u062F\u0645: ${message.from.username ? "@" + message.from.username : "\u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u062A\u0648\u0641\u0631"}
Telegram ID: ${userId}
\u0627\u0644\u0628\u0627\u0642\u0629: ${plan?.name || pending.plan}
\u0627\u0644\u0645\u0628\u0644\u063A: ${pending.amount_sar} \u0631.\u0633

\u26A0\uFE0F \u062A\u062D\u0642\u0642 \u0645\u0646 \u0648\u0635\u0648\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0628\u0644\u063A \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0646\u0643 \u0642\u0628\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0641\u0642\u0629.`;
  const method = photo ? "sendPhoto" : "sendDocument";
  const receiptId = photo || doc.file_id;
  await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, method, {
    chat_id: adminGroup,
    [photo ? "photo" : "document"]: receiptId,
    caption,
    reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [[
      { text: "\u2705 \u0645\u0648\u0627\u0641\u0642\u0629", callback_data: `sub_approve:${pending.id}` },
      { text: "\u274C \u0631\u0641\u0636", callback_data: `sub_reject:${pending.id}` }
    ]] }
  });
  await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE subscription_requests SET status='PENDING', receipt_file_id=? WHERE id=? AND telegram_user_id=? AND status='AWAITING_RECEIPT'").bind(receiptId, pending.id, userId).run();
  await reply(env, userId, `\u2705 \u0627\u0633\u062A\u0644\u0645\u0646\u0627 \u0625\u064A\u0635\u0627\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628 #${pending.id} \u0648\u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644\u0646\u0627\u0647 \u0644\u0644\u0625\u062F\u0627\u0631\u0629.
\u23F3 \u0633\u062A\u0635\u0644\u0643 \u0631\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0629 \u0628\u0639\u062F \u0645\u0631\u0627\u062C\u0639\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0648\u064A\u0644.`);
  return true;
}

function subscriptionDateSaudiParts(value) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Riyadh",
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
    hourCycle: "h23"
  }).formatToParts(new Date(value));
  const part = /* @__PURE__ */ __name2((type) => parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value || "", "part");
  const hour = Number(part("hour"));
  return {
    date: `${part("day")}/${part("month")}/${part("year")}`,
    time: `${String(hour % 12 || 12).padStart(2, "0")}:${part("minute")} ${hour < 12 ? "\u0635\u0628\u0627\u062D\u064B\u0627" : "\u0645\u0633\u0627\u0621\u064B"}`
  };
}

async function reviewSubscription(env, callback, approve, requestId) {
  const adminGroup = String(env.ADMIN_GROUP_ID || "");
  if (String(callback.from?.id) !== ADMIN_USER_ID || String(callback.message?.chat?.id) !== adminGroup) {
    await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: callback.id, text: "\u26D4 \u0647\u0630\u0627 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u062C\u0631\u0627\u0621 \u0644\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0631 \u0641\u0642\u0637.", show_alert: true });
    return;
  }
  const row = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM subscription_requests WHERE id = ?").bind(requestId).first();
  if (!row || row.status !== "PENDING" || !PLANS[row.plan]) {
    await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: callback.id, text: "\u0647\u0630\u0627 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628 \u062A\u0645\u062A \u0645\u0631\u0627\u062C\u0639\u062A\u0647 \u0623\u0648 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0635\u0627\u0644\u062D.", show_alert: true });
    return;
  }
  const newStatus = approve ? "APPROVED" : "REJECTED";
  const updated = await env.DB.prepare("UPDATE subscription_requests SET status=?, admin_user_id=?, reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=? AND status='PENDING' RETURNING id").bind(newStatus, ADMIN_USER_ID, requestId).first();
  if (!updated) {
    await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: callback.id, text: "\u062A\u0645\u062A \u0645\u0631\u0627\u062C\u0639\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0628\u0627\u0644\u0641\u0639\u0644.", show_alert: true });
    return;
  }
  let expiry = null;
  let activatedAt = null;
  if (approve) {
    const old = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT expires_at FROM subscriptions WHERE telegram_user_id=?").bind(row.telegram_user_id).first();
    const oldMs = Date.parse(old?.expires_at || "");
    activatedAt = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date();
    const startMs = Number.isFinite(oldMs) && oldMs > activatedAt.getTime() ? oldMs : activatedAt.getTime();
    expiry = new Date(startMs + 30 * 864e5).toISOString();
    await env.DB.prepare("INSERT INTO subscriptions (telegram_user_id,plan,daily_route_limit,started_at,expires_at,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,?,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT(telegram_user_id) DO UPDATE SET plan=excluded.plan,daily_route_limit=excluded.daily_route_limit,started_at=excluded.started_at,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP").bind(row.telegram_user_id, row.plan, PLANS[row.plan].routes, expiry).run();
  }
  await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: callback.id, text: approve ? "\u062A\u0645\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0641\u0642\u0629" : "\u062A\u0645 \u0631\u0641\u0636 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628" });
  await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "editMessageReplyMarkup", { chat_id: adminGroup, message_id: callback.message.message_id, reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [] } });
  await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "sendMessage", { chat_id: adminGroup, text: `${approve ? "\u2705 \u062A\u0645\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0648\u0627\u0641\u0642\u0629" : "\u274C \u062A\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u0641\u0636"} \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0644\u0628 #${requestId} \u0628\u0648\u0627\u0633\u0637\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u064A\u0631.` });
  try {
    const start = approve ? subscriptionDateSaudiParts(activatedAt) : null;
    const end = approve ? subscriptionDateSaudiParts(expiry) : null;
    const isRenewal = approve && Date.parse(expiry) - activatedAt.getTime() > 30 * 864e5 + 6e4;
    const successMessage = approve ? [
      "\u2705 \u062A\u0645 \u062A\u0641\u0639\u064A\u0644 \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643\u0643 \u0628\u0646\u062C\u0627\u062D!",
      "",
      `\u{1F48E} \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0627\u0642\u0629: ${PLANS[row.plan].name}`,
      `\u{1F4B0} \u0642\u064A\u0645\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643: ${PLANS[row.plan].price} \u0631\u064A\u0627\u0644 \u0633\u0639\u0648\u062F\u064A`,
      "",
      "\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501",
      "\u{1F4C5} \u062A\u0641\u0627\u0635\u064A\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643",
      "\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501",
      "",
      `\u{1F7E2} \u062A\u0627\u0631\u064A\u062E \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0641\u0639\u064A\u0644: ${start.date}`,
      `\u{1F558} \u0648\u0642\u062A \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0641\u0639\u064A\u0644: ${start.time}`,
      "",
      `\u{1F534} \u062A\u0627\u0631\u064A\u062E \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u0627\u0621: ${end.date}`,
      `\u{1F558} \u0648\u0642\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u0627\u0621: ${end.time}`,
      "",
      "\u23F3 \u0645\u062F\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0627\u0642\u0629: 30 \u064A\u0648\u0645\u064B\u0627" + (isRenewal ? " (\u0623\u064F\u0636\u064A\u0641\u062A \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062F\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062A\u0628\u0642\u064A\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643\u0643)" : ""),
      "\u{1F1F8}\u{1F1E6} \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0648\u0642\u064A\u062A: \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0639\u0648\u062F\u064A\u0629",
      "",
      "\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501",
      "\u26A1 \u0645\u0645\u064A\u0632\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643\u0643",
      "\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501\u2501",
      "",
      `\u{1F5FA}\uFE0F \u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 ${PLANS[row.plan].routes} \u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629 \u062E\u0644\u0627\u0644 24 \u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629.`,
      "\u{1F504} \u062A\u062A\u062C\u062F\u062F \u0645\u062D\u0627\u0648\u0644\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062E\u0637\u064A\u0637 \u0643\u0644 24 \u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u0628\u062F\u0627\u064A\u0629 \u0646\u0627\u0641\u0630\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0633\u062A\u062E\u062F\u0627\u0645.",
      "",
      "\u0634\u0643\u0631\u064B\u0627 \u0644\u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643\u0643 \u0641\u064A GCC EV Chargers \u26A1"
    ].join("\n") : `\u274C \u062A\u0645 \u0631\u0641\u0636 \u0637\u0644\u0628 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643 #${requestId}.
\u0625\u0630\u0627 \u0643\u0627\u0646 \u0647\u0646\u0627\u0643 \u062E\u0637\u0623 \u0641\u064A \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062D\u0648\u064A\u0644\u060C \u062A\u0648\u0627\u0635\u0644 \u0645\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u062F\u0627\u0631\u0629.`;
    await reply(env, row.telegram_user_id, successMessage);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("SUB_CUSTOMER_NOTIFICATION_FAILED", requestId, String(e));

async function batteryEnsureTables(db) {
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_calculator_state (
    chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    route_km REAL NOT NULL,
    stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ready',
    capacity_kwh REAL,
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  )`).run();
  await db.prepare(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS battery_calculator_trials (
    telegram_user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    used_at TEXT
  )`).run();
}
__name(batteryEnsureTables, "batteryEnsureTables");
__name2(batteryEnsureTables, "batteryEnsureTables");
async function batteryHasSubscription(db, userId) {
  const subscription = await db.prepare(
    "SELECT plan, expires_at FROM subscriptions WHERE telegram_user_id = ?"
  ).bind(String(userId)).first();
  return Boolean(
    subscription && PLANS[subscription.plan] && Date.parse(subscription.expires_at || "") > Date.now()
  );
}
__name(batteryHasSubscription, "batteryHasSubscription");
__name2(batteryHasSubscription, "batteryHasSubscription");
async function batteryCanUse(db, userId) {
  if (await batteryHasSubscription(db, userId)) {
    return { allowed: true, paid: true };
  }
  const trial = await db.prepare(
    "SELECT used FROM battery_calculator_trials WHERE telegram_user_id = ?"
  ).bind(String(userId)).first();
  return {
    allowed: Number(trial?.used || 0) === 0,
    paid: false
  };
}
__name(batteryCanUse, "batteryCanUse");
__name2(batteryCanUse, "batteryCanUse");
async function batterySaveRoute(env, chat, km) {
  await batteryEnsureTables(env.DB);
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO battery_calculator_state
      (chat_id, route_km, stage, capacity_kwh, updated_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, 'ready', NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    ON CONFLICT(chat_id) DO UPDATE SET
      route_km = excluded.route_km,
      stage = 'ready',
      capacity_kwh = NULL,
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  `).bind(String(chat), km).run();
  const access = await batteryCanUse(env.DB, chat);
  if (access.allowed) {
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      access.paid ?       {

async function batteryStart(env, callback) {
  const chat = callback.message?.chat?.id;
  const userId = callback.from?.id;
  await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", {
    callback_query_id: callback.id
  });
  if (!chat || !userId || String(chat) !== String(userId)) return;
  await batteryEnsureTables(env.DB);
  const state = await env.DB.prepare(
    "SELECT route_km FROM battery_calculator_state WHERE chat_id = ?"
  ).bind(String(chat)).first();
  if (!state || !Number.isFinite(Number(state.route_km))) {
    await reply(env, chat, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u0627\u062D\u0633\u0628 \u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F\u0629 \u0623\u0648\u0644\u0627.");
    return;
  }
  const access = await batteryCanUse(env.DB, userId);
  if (!access.allowed) {
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      "\u{1F512} \u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u062A \u062A\u062C\u0631\u0628\u062A\u0643 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062C\u0627\u0646\u064A\u0629. \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0643 \u0644\u0644\u0627\u0633\u062A\u0641\u0627\u062F\u0629 \u0645\u0646 \u062D\u0627\u0633\u0628\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629.",
      {
        inline_keyboard: [[{
          text: "\u2B50 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0627\u0643\u0627\u062A",
          callback_data: "battery_subscribe"
        }]]
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    UPDATE battery_calculator_state
    SET stage = 'capacity',
        capacity_kwh = NULL,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE chat_id = ?
  `).bind(String(chat)).run();
  await reply(
    env,
    chat,
    "\u{1F50B} \u0623\u062F\u062E\u0644 \u0633\u0639\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u0628\u0627\u0644\u0643\u064A\u0644\u0648\u0648\u0627\u0637 \u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629 (kWh).\n\n\u0645\u062B\u0627\u0644: 75 \u0623\u0648 100\n\n\u064A\u0645\u0643\u0646\u0643 \u0625\u0631\u0633\u0627\u0644 /cancel \u0644\u0644\u0625\u0644\u063A\u0627\u0621."
  );
}

async function batteryHandleText(env, chat, userId, text) {
  await batteryEnsureTables(env.DB);
  const state = await env.DB.prepare(
    "SELECT * FROM battery_calculator_state WHERE chat_id = ?"
  ).bind(String(chat)).first();
  if (!state || !["capacity", "consumption"].includes(state.stage)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (text === "/cancel") {
    await env.DB.prepare(
      "UPDATE battery_calculator_state SET stage = 'ready' WHERE chat_id = ?"
    ).bind(String(chat)).run();
    await reply(env, chat, "\u062A\u0645 \u0625\u0644\u063A\u0627\u0621 \u062D\u0633\u0627\u0628 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629.");
    return true;
  }
  const value = Number(String(text).trim().replace(",", "."));
  if (state.stage === "capacity") {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 5 || value > 250) {
      await reply(env, chat, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u0623\u062F\u062E\u0644 \u0633\u0639\u0629 \u0628\u0637\u0627\u0631\u064A\u0629 \u0635\u062D\u064A\u062D\u0629 \u0628\u064A\u0646 5 \u0648250 kWh.");
      return true;
    }
    await env.DB.prepare(`
      UPDATE battery_calculator_state
      SET capacity_kwh = ?,
          stage = 'consumption',
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE chat_id = ?
    `).bind(value, String(chat)).run();
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      "\u26A1 \u0623\u062F\u062E\u0644 \u0645\u0639\u062F\u0644 \u0627\u0633\u062A\u0647\u0644\u0627\u0643 \u0633\u064A\u0627\u0631\u062A\u0643 \u0639\u0646\u062F \u0633\u0631\u0639\u0629 120 \u0643\u0645/\u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629.\n\n\u0627\u0644\u0648\u062D\u062F\u0629: kWh \u0644\u0643\u0644 100 \u0643\u0645\n\u0645\u062B\u0627\u0644: 22\n\n\u064A\u0645\u0643\u0646\u0643 \u0625\u0631\u0633\u0627\u0644 /cancel \u0644\u0644\u0625\u0644\u063A\u0627\u0621."
    );
    return true;
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 5 || value > 60) {
    await reply(env, chat, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u0623\u062F\u062E\u0644 \u0645\u0639\u062F\u0644 \u0627\u0633\u062A\u0647\u0644\u0627\u0643 \u0635\u062D\u064A\u062D\u0627 \u0628\u064A\u0646 5 \u064860 kWh/100 km.");
    return true;
  }
  const capacity = Number(state.capacity_kwh);
  const distance = Number(state.route_km);
  if (!Number.isFinite(capacity) || !Number.isFinite(distance) || capacity <= 0 || distance <= 0) {
    await reply(env, chat, "\u26A0\uFE0F \u0628\u064A\u0627\u0646\u0627\u062A \u0627\u0644\u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629 \u063A\u064A\u0631 \u0645\u0643\u062A\u0645\u0644\u0629. \u0627\u0628\u062F\u0623 \u0631\u062D\u0644\u0629 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F\u0629.");
    return true;
  }
  const required = distance * value / 100;
  const usedPercent = required / capacity * 100;
  const remainingPercent = 100 - usedPercent;
  const access = await batteryCanUse(env.DB, userId);
  if (!access.allowed) {
    await env.DB.prepare(
      "UPDATE battery_calculator_state SET stage = 'ready' WHERE chat_id = ?"
    ).bind(String(chat)).run();
    await reply(env, chat, "\u{1F512} \u0627\u0646\u062A\u0647\u062A \u062A\u062C\u0631\u0628\u062A\u0643 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062C\u0627\u0646\u064A\u0629. \u0627\u0634\u062A\u0631\u0643 \u0644\u0627\u0633\u062A\u062E\u062F\u0627\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u062D\u0627\u0633\u0628\u0629.");
    return true;
  }
  const batteryTrialClaimId = !access.paid ? crypto.randomUUID() : null;
  if (!access.paid) {
    await env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO battery_calculator_trials
        (telegram_user_id, used)
      VALUES (?, 0)
    `).bind(String(userId)).run();
    const claim = await env.DB.prepare(`
      UPDATE battery_calculator_trials
      SET used = 1,
          used_at = ?
      WHERE telegram_user_id = ?
        AND used = 0
    `).bind(batteryTrialClaimId, String(userId)).run();
    if ((claim.meta?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) {
      await reply(env, chat, "\u{1F512} \u062A\u0645 \u0627\u0633\u062A\u062E\u062F\u0627\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u062C\u0631\u0628\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062C\u0627\u0646\u064A\u0629 \u0645\u0633\u0628\u0642\u0627.");
      return true;
    }
  }
  await env.DB.prepare(`
    UPDATE battery_calculator_state
    SET stage = 'ready',
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE chat_id = ?
  `).bind(String(chat)).run();
  const f = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((n) => n.toFixed(1), "f");

    "",

    "",
    remainingPercent < 10 ? async function notifyReleaseOnce(env, message) {
  if (message.chat?.type !== "private") return;
  const chatId = String(message.chat.id);
  try {
    const claim = await env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO bot_release_notices (
        chat_id,
        release_version
      )
      VALUES (?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(chat_id, release_version) DO NOTHING
    `).bind(chatId, BOT_RELEASE_VERSION).run();
    if (Number(claim.meta?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) {
      return;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "Release notification database error:",
      error
    );
    return;
  }
  try {
    await reply(
      env,
      message.chat.id,
      BOT_RELEASE_MESSAGE,
      MAIN_MENU
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "Release notification delivery error:",
      error
    );
  }
}

      "\u{1F4CD} \u0627\u0636\u063A\u0637 \u0645\u0634\u0627\u0631\u0643\u0629 \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u064A \u0644\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0639\u0646 \u0623\u0642\u0631\u0628 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A."
    );
    return;
  }
  if (text === "\u26A1 \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0633\u0631\u064A\u0639 DC" || text === "\u{1F50C} \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0639\u0627\u062F\u064A AC") {
    const mode = text.includes("DC") ? "DC" : "AC";
    await saveState(
      env.DB,
      chat,
      null,
      mode
    );
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      `\u2705 \u062A\u0645 \u0627\u062E\u062A\u064A\u0627\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0634\u062D\u0646 ${mode}.

\u{1F4CD} \u0627\u0636\u063A\u0637 \u0645\u0634\u0627\u0631\u0643\u0629 \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u064A \u0644\u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0623\u0642\u0631\u0628 3 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A.`,
      CHARGER_TYPE_MENU
    );
    return;
  }
  if (text === "\u{1F6E0}\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0625\u0628\u0644\u0627\u063A \u0639\u0646 \u0645\u0634\u0643\u0644\u0629" || text === "\u2795 \u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F\u0629") {
    await saveState(
      env.DB,
      chat,
      null,
      "ALL"
    );
    const title = text === "\u{1F6E0}\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0625\u0628\u0644\u0627\u063A \u0639\u0646 \u0645\u0634\u0643\u0644\u0629" ? "\u{1F6E0}\uFE0F \u0646\u0645\u0648\u0630\u062C \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0644\u0627\u063A\u0627\u062A" : "\u2795 \u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629 \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F\u0629";
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      `${title}

\u0627\u0641\u062A\u062D \u0627\u0644\u0646\u0645\u0648\u0630\u062C \u0648\u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0646\u0648\u0639 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0644\u0627\u063A \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0646\u0627\u0633\u0628.
\u0646\u0641\u0633 \u0627\u0644\u0646\u0645\u0648\u0630\u062C \u0645\u062E\u0635\u0635 \u0644\u0644\u0623\u0639\u0637\u0627\u0644 \u0648\u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A.`,
      {
        inline_keyboard: [[{
          text: "\u{1F4DD} \u0641\u062A\u062D \u0646\u0645\u0648\u0630\u062C Google",
          url: FORM_URL
        }]]
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  const searchState = await env.DB.prepare(`

    SELECT search_active

    FROM user_search_state

    WHERE chat_id = ?

  `).bind(
    String(chat)
  ).first();
  if (Number(searchState?.search_active) === 1 && text && !text.startsWith("/")) {
    const keyword = text.slice(0, 100);
    const page = await searchStations(
      env.DB,
      keyword,
      0
    );
    await env.DB.prepare(`

      UPDATE user_search_state

      SET

        search_query = ?,

        page_offset = 0,

        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

      WHERE chat_id = ?

    `).bind(
      keyword,
      String(chat)
    ).run();
    if (!page.stations.length) {
      await reply(
        env,
        chat,
        `\u{1F50D} \u0644\u0645 \u0646\u062C\u062F \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u062A\u0637\u0627\u0628\u0642: ${keyword}

\u062C\u0631\u0651\u0628 \u0631\u0642\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629 \u0623\u0648 \u0627\u0633\u0645\u0647\u0627 \u0628\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0631\u0628\u064A\u0629 \u0623\u0648 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u0646\u062C\u0644\u064A\u0632\u064A\u0629.`
      );
      return;
    }
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      pageMessage(
        page.stations,
        0,
        `\u{1F50D} \u0646\u062A\u0627\u0626\u062C \u0627\u0644\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0639\u0646: ${keyword}`
      ),
      directionsKeyboard(
        page.stations,
        0,
        page.hasMore,
        "search_more"
      )
    );
    return;
  }
  await reply(
    env,
    chat,
    "\u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0625\u062D\u062F\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u062E\u062F\u0645\u0627\u062A \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u0627\u0626\u0645\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0631\u0626\u064A\u0633\u064A\u0629."
  );
}
__name(handleMessage, "handleMessage");
