async function handleSearchMore(env, callback) {
  const chat = callback.message?.chat?.id;
  if (!chat) {
    return;
  }
  const match = /^search_more:(\d+)$/.exec(
    callback.data || ""
  );
  if (!match) {
    return;
  }
  const requestedOffset = Number(match[1]);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(requestedOffset) || requestedOffset < 3 || requestedOffset > 3e3 || requestedOffset % 3 !== 0) {
    return;
  }
  const state = await env.DB.prepare(`

    SELECT

      search_active,

      search_query,

      page_offset

    FROM user_search_state

    WHERE chat_id = ?

  `).bind(
    String(chat)
  ).first();
  if (Number(state?.search_active) !== 1 || !state?.search_query) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u0627\u0628\u062F\u0623 \u0628\u062D\u062B\u064B\u0627 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F\u064B\u0627 \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0642\u0627\u0626\u0645\u0629."
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  const currentOffset = Number(
    state.page_offset || 0
  );
  if (requestedOffset !== currentOffset + 3) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u0647\u0630\u0647 \u0635\u0641\u062D\u0629 \u0642\u062F\u064A\u0645\u0629. \u0627\u0633\u062A\u062E\u062F\u0645 \u0623\u062D\u062F\u062B \u0627\u0644\u0646\u062A\u0627\u0626\u062C."
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  const page = await searchStations(
    env.DB,
    state.search_query,
    requestedOffset
  );
  if (!page.stations.length) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u0644\u0627 \u062A\u0648\u062C\u062F \u0646\u062A\u0627\u0626\u062C \u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u064A\u0629."
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  const update = await env.DB.prepare(`

    UPDATE user_search_state

    SET

      page_offset = ?,

      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

    WHERE chat_id = ?

      AND page_offset = ?

      AND search_active = 1

      AND search_query = ?

  `).bind(
    requestedOffset,
    String(chat),
    currentOffset,
    state.search_query
  ).run();
  if ((update.meta?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u062A\u0645 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0647\u0630\u0647 \u0627\u0644\u0635\u0641\u062D\u0629 \u0633\u0627\u0628\u0642\u064B\u0627."
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  await telegram(
    env.BOT_TOKEN,
    "answerCallbackQuery",
    {
      callback_query_id: callback.id
    }
  );
  await reply(
    env,
    chat,
    pageMessage(
      page.stations,
      requestedOffset,
      `\u{1F50D} \u0646\u062A\u0627\u0626\u062C \u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u064A\u0629: ${state.search_query}`
    ),
    directionsKeyboard(
      page.stations,
      requestedOffset,
      page.hasMore,
      "search_more"
    )
  );
}
__name(handleSearchMore, "handleSearchMore");
__name2(handleSearchMore, "handleSearchMore");
async function handleMoreStations(env, callback) {
  const chat = callback.message?.chat?.id;
  if (!chat) {
    return;
  }
  const match = /^more_stations:(\d+)$/.exec(
    callback.data || ""
  );
  if (!match) {
    return;
  }
  const requestedOffset = Number(match[1]);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(requestedOffset) || requestedOffset < 3 || requestedOffset > 3e3 || requestedOffset % 3 !== 0) {
    return;
  }
  const state = await getState(
    env.DB,
    chat
  );
  if (state.last_latitude == null || state.last_longitude == null) {
    await reply(
      env,
      chat,
      "\u{1F4CD} \u0623\u0631\u0633\u0644 \u0645\u0648\u0642\u0639\u0643 \u0623\u0648\u0644\u064B\u0627 \u0644\u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0632\u064A\u062F \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A."
    );
    return;
  }
  const currentOffset = Number(
    state.page_offset || 0
  );
  if (requestedOffset !== currentOffset + 3) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u0647\u0630\u0647 \u0635\u0641\u062D\u0629 \u0642\u062F\u064A\u0645\u0629. \u0627\u0633\u062A\u062E\u062F\u0645 \u0632\u0631 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0632\u064A\u062F \u0641\u064A \u0623\u062D\u062F\u062B \u0627\u0644\u0646\u062A\u0627\u0626\u062C.",
        show_alert: false
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  const page = await findPage(
    env.DB,
    Number(state.last_latitude),
    Number(state.last_longitude),
    state,
    requestedOffset
  );
  if (!page.stations.length) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u0648\u0635\u0644\u062A \u0625\u0644\u0649 \u0622\u062E\u0631 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0629 \u0645\u062A\u0627\u062D\u0629."
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  const update = await env.DB.prepare(`

    UPDATE user_search_state

    SET

      page_offset = ?,

      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

    WHERE chat_id = ?

      AND page_offset = ?

      AND last_latitude IS NOT NULL

      AND last_longitude IS NOT NULL

  `).bind(
    requestedOffset,
    String(chat),
    currentOffset
  ).run();
  if ((update.meta?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) {
    await telegram(
      env.BOT_TOKEN,
      "answerCallbackQuery",
      {
        callback_query_id: callback.id,
        text: "\u062A\u0645 \u0639\u0631\u0636 \u0647\u0630\u0647 \u0627\u0644\u0635\u0641\u062D\u0629 \u0633\u0627\u0628\u0642\u064B\u0627."
      }
    );
    return;
  }
  await telegram(
    env.BOT_TOKEN,
    "answerCallbackQuery",
    {
      callback_query_id: callback.id
    }
  );
  await reply(
    env,
    chat,
    pageMessage(
      page.stations,
      requestedOffset,
      "\u26A1 \u0645\u062D\u0637\u0627\u062A \u0634\u062D\u0646 \u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u064A\u0629"
    ),
    directionsKeyboard(
      page.stations,
      requestedOffset,
      page.hasMore
    )
  );
}
__name(handleMoreStations, "handleMoreStations");
__name2(handleMoreStations, "handleMoreStations");
var GeoRateLimiter = class extends DurableObject {
  static {
    __name(this, "GeoRateLimiter");
  }
  static {
    __name2(this, "GeoRateLimiter");
  }
  constructor(ctx, env) {
    super(ctx, env);
    this.ctx = ctx;
    this.env = env;
  }
  async acquire() {
    return this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
      const now = Date.now();
      const next = Number(await txn.get("nextRequestAt") || 0);
      if (now < next) {
        return { allowed: false, retryAfterMs: next - now };
      }
      await txn.put("nextRequestAt", now + 1100);
      return { allowed: true };
    });
  }
};
var GCC_EV_Chargers_V5_12_default = {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (url.pathname === "/test-city" && env.TEST_MODE === "true") {
      const city = url.searchParams.get("name") || "";
      const result = await findCityPoint(null, city, env);
      return Response.json(result);
    }
    if (request.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/") {
      if (!env.DB) {
        return new Response(
          "Database binding missing",
          {
            status: 503
          }
        );
      }
      try {
        const row = await env.DB.prepare(
          "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM stations"
        ).first();
        return new Response(
          `GCC EV Chargers Bot is running! Stations: ${row.total}`
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(
          "D1 count error",
          error
        );
        return new Response(
          "Database error",
          {
            status: 503
          }
        );
      }
    }
    if (request.method !== "POST" || url.pathname !== "/webhook") {
      return new Response(
        "Not Found",
        {
          status: 404
        }
      );
    }
    if (!env.BOT_TOKEN || !env.WEBHOOK_SECRET || !env.DB) {
      return new Response(
        "Configuration missing",
        {
          status: 503
        }
      );
    }
    if (request.headers.get(
      "X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token"
    ) !== env.WEBHOOK_SECRET) {
      return new Response(
        "Forbidden",
        {
          status: 403
        }
      );
    }
    let update;
    try {
      update = await request.json();
    } catch {
      return new Response(
        "Invalid JSON",
        {
          status: 400
        }
      );
    }
    try {
      if (update.callback_query) {
        const callbackData = update.callback_query.data || "";
        if (/^sub_plan:(SILVER|GOLD|VIP)$/.test(callbackData)) {
          await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: update.callback_query.id });
          await previewSubscription(env, update.callback_query, callbackData.split(":")[1]);
        } else if (/^sub_confirm:(SILVER|GOLD|VIP)$/.test(callbackData)) {
          await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: update.callback_query.id });
          await chooseSubscription(env, update.callback_query, callbackData.split(":")[1]);
        } else if (callbackData === "sub_back") {
          await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: update.callback_query.id });
          if (update.callback_query.message?.chat?.type === "private" && String(update.callback_query.message.chat.id) === String(update.callback_query.from.id)) {
            await subscriptionOverview(env, String(update.callback_query.from.id));
          }
        } else if (callbackData === "sub_status") {
          await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", { callback_query_id: update.callback_query.id });
          if (update.callback_query.message?.chat?.type === "private" && String(update.callback_query.message.chat.id) === String(update.callback_query.from.id)) await subscriptionStatus(env, update.callback_query.from.id);
        } else if (/^sub_(approve|reject):\d+$/.test(callbackData)) {
          const m = /^sub_(approve|reject):(\d+)$/.exec(callbackData);
          await reviewSubscription(env, update.callback_query, m[1] === "approve", Number(m[2]));
        } else if (callbackData.startsWith("search_more:")) {
          await handleSearchMore(
            env,
            update.callback_query
          );
        } else if (callbackData === "battery_start") {
          await batteryStart(env, update.callback_query);
        } else if (callbackData === "battery_subscribe") {
          await telegram(env.BOT_TOKEN, "answerCallbackQuery", {
            callback_query_id: update.callback_query.id
          });
          await subscriptionOverview(
            env,
            String(update.callback_query.from.id)
          );
        } else if (callbackData.startsWith("trip_more:")) {
          await handleTripMore(env, update.callback_query);
        } else if (callbackData.startsWith("more_stations:")) {
          await handleMoreStations(
            env,
            update.callback_query
          );
        } else {
          await telegram(
            env.BOT_TOKEN,
            "answerCallbackQuery",
            {
              callback_query_id: update.callback_query.id
            }
          );
        }
        return new Response("OK");
      }
      if (!update.message?.chat?.id) {
        return new Response("OK");
      }
      await handleMessage(
        env,
        update.message
      );
      return new Response("OK");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Bot processing error",
        error
      );
      return new Response(
        "Processing error",
        {
          status: 500
        }
      );
    }
  }
};
export {
  GeoRateLimiter,
  GCC_EV_Chargers_V5_12_default as default
};
